name: Kuga Ryokuha
source:
—Atonement—

A 3rd year student at Marenis High School.
A serious, leader-type person who is well-liked and trusted by everyone.
His father is a priest of the Marenis religion, and he has been told to become a priest himself in the future.
His heterochromia was acquired later in life.
He likes penny candy.

"For what it's worth, I'll also be serving as the leader of this committee. Nice to meet you."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=1]official website[/url]]
